title: Tachyonics
description: Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.

puzzle.goal: A hypothetical particle has a mass that is purely imaginary, m = iμ with μ real. Write the square of its energy from the invariant that relates energy, momentum p and mass for any free particle, keeping the imaginary mass explicitly.
puzzle.name: Mass-shell relation for imaginary (tachyonic) mass
puzzle.ask: Its speed is v = pc²/E, so (v/c)² = p²c²/E² = 1 + μ²c⁴/E². Find (v/c)² for a particle with μc² = 3 GeV and E = @{E} GeV (μ and E below are in GeV).

vars.\u03bc: real mass scale, m = iμ (here μc² in GeV)

puzzle.method: Start from E² − p²c² = m²c⁴ and substitute m = iμ; the sign of the mass term flips, so the speed is always above c.
